text:
maya: heads up — automated scanner flagged a new CVE affecting our ingress controller images (CVE-2026-2890). seen in prod clusters in us-west-2 and eu-central-1. anyone on triage? :eyes:

ops-bot: [vuln-scan] 1949001001: nginx-ingress-controller:1.5.2 -> CVE-2026-2890 (privilege escalation via config parsing). details: https://vuln-db.example/cve/CVE-2026-2890

sahil: I can take initial triage. quick Q: does this require kubelet/etcd cert rotation or just bumping the ingress image?

maya: initial look suggests it's in controller binary parsing configmaps -> exploit path doesn't touch kubelet/etcd directly. cert-manager may be implicated for renewals if we need rolling restarts.

alina: if it's just controller, plan: 1) identify clusters with old image via `kubectl -n ingress get deploy -o jsonpath='{..image}'` 2) schedule canary rollout in spare capacity cluster 3) monitor audit logs for abnormal configmap writes.

dmitri: workaround if we need a hotfix: `kubectl -n ingress set image deploy/nginx-ingress-controller nginx-ingress-controller=nginx-ingress-controller:1.5.3-patched` then monitor. also add network policy to restrict configmap sources temporarily.

maya: RBAC question — should we tighten the controller ServiceAccount while patching? e.g., remove broad `configmaps` watch and bind a narrower role for only `ingress-nginx` configmaps. any blockers for that?

sahil: +1 on tightening RBAC. caveat: helm chart automates rolebinding; we'll need to adjust chart values and push to our internal charts repo. I can prepare a `values.yaml` diff and asmall helm patch.

alina: also need to ensure audit logging captures `configmap` patch events before we roll. if audit webhook is dropping some events due to volume we should bump the sampling temporarily. pinging @sre-oncall for capacity.

sre-oncall: we have headroom in us-west-2 for increased webhook throughput for 2 hours. I'll keep an eye on the queue. :white_check_mark:

maya: KMS/key rotation: cert-manager uses our KMS for ACME private key encryption. If we restart cert-manager during rotation, do we risk losing access to keys? anyone with direct KMS integration knowledge?

dmitri: cert-manager stores private keys in secrets encrypted via KMS only if we enabled envelope encryption. currently we use KMS for DB keys only; secrets are standard kubernetes secrets in sops. so no direct KMS hot-path for cert-manager in prod. but double-check Helm values: `extraArgs: --vault-provider=kms` (unlikely but search).

sahil: I'll grep charts: `rg "kms" charts/ | sed -n '1,200p'` — will report back. if cert-manager is using KMS, we need a maintenance window for key rotation and ensure decrypt works on nodes.

ops-bot: [scan-note] 1949001105: cluster eu-central-1 has 7 pods running vulnerable image (deploy/nginx-ingress-controller). 3 are on nodes with taints that limit quick replacement.

alina: for rollout sequencing: canary in us-west-2 -> validate configmap edit telemetry -> if pass, rollout to eu-central-1 but drain nodes with taints first to avoid stuck pods. include post-rollback quick checks: `kubectl get events -n ingress --field-selector reason=FailedCreate`.

maya: any compliance note re audit retention? security wants 90 days of configmap change history for RCA. our current retention is 30d.

sahil: file a request with retention team. for emergency we can export audit logs to S3 with `kubectl logs` or webhook backup. I'll open ticket.

dmitri: small checklist I'm proposing: - create hotfix image tag 1.5.3-patched - helm chart patch + RBAC narrowing - canary in spare cluster - increase audit webhook throughput during canary - KMS cert-manager grep and confirm - escalate if cert-manager uses KMS -> schedule rotation window - post-rollback playbook + slack alert channel :shipit:

maya: thanks. sahil + dmitri, can you coordinate on the helm patch and include rollout annotation `redwood/security-triage: 1949001001` so console picks it up?

sahil: on it. I'll draft the PR and include `helm test` steps. expected PR within 2h.

alina: I'll prepare the canary dashboard and alert thresholds (configmap write rate, 5xx from ingress, pod restart spikes).

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] 1949001400: created incident-1949001001 with severity=high (manual triage by sahil). link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1949001001

sre-oncall: if you need cross-region capacity, shout here. I'll coordinate node drains and taint clears.

maya: perfect. let's keep updates here. attach any PR links and timeline in the incident ticket.

sahil: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/charts/ingress/compare/patch-rbac-1949001001 - includes RBAC removal for cluster-wide configmap watch and new role names. testing now.

maya: thanks, closing loop: if cert-manager involves KMS we'll pause patch and run key-decrypt test. otherwise proceed with canary and full rollout. :lock:

(End of thread)
